We all agreed on the view of quantum physics that everything has a state and a probability and the reality is just a set or network of all possibility of events can happen link up together. We bring up evidence from Schrodinger's Cat, the double slit of electron n photon experiment, Stern Gerlach Experiment… And we conclude that there is always possibility that 1 we watch and the cat is death, 2 one electron go through both slit at the same time different state, or 3 the car will pass through the wall, they are always exists but so so small that it mostly never happen, and because we have no way to guarantee the possibility of these scenario = 0 therefore its not 0 n in some moment we can see the glitches of the world. Some glitches can be mentioned like we cant travel faster than light speed  otherwise we can see the future event before it was constructed by the brain (the brain need input from the world image, sound… they all wave based energy then construct an output of reality, basically what we are seeing is always the past state of an object not the current one), or why are there so many fundamental constants in the universe like pi, fibonaci, light speed… and what fixed their value. Think conceptually and relate to coding, seems like they are some predefined parameters in the .env file in the universe program, kinda make sense right. Now design the architecture of the universe we can project it all on a multi dimensional space n-D interweaving stacking and linking up together, like what we see in the final scene of Interstellar when the father was attracted and fell into a blackhole and inside that blackhole is this multi dimensional space. From here we can form a hypothesis that this whole universe of reality is a blackhole, the information/data of this whole is stored on the surface of the blackhole and the reality is an architecture of multi dimensional space built on these information.
